messages:
tess: Heads-up: scheduling base-image rebase on Monday 09:30 PT. Key aims: drop CAP_NET_RAW + CAP_SYS_PTRACE where feasible, enable strict seccomp and userns remap, and rotate cosign signer + switch keystore operator to per-cluster KMS aliases.

omar: Rolling canary plan? and what's the keystore key naming convention?

tess: Canary: internal -> staging -> prod-canary -> rest. 15m windows. Keystore aliases will be `projects/redwood/keys/keystore-<cluster>` so we can revoke per-cluster.

lee: RBAC cleanup required before image flip 12: a few bake-runner SAs still have broad clusterrolebindings. I'll open a migration PR that narrows to job.create and pod.exec and adds an audit annotation `sec.redwood/audit=SEC-7700`.

hina: SOC/legal ask: logs must be WORM for 1y and attestable. How will we attach provenance?

tess: CI will emit SBOM + cosign attestation and a signed manifest per-batch; logs are written to a WORM bucket encrypted with the cluster KEK. ops-bot: created SEC-7700 for manifest schema & retention.

omar: incident runbook note: if keystore rewrap fails during rollout, fallback is decrypt with old KEK and rewrap. Owner?

hina: I'll author the runbook with exact gcloud commands + temporary admin impersonation steps. Put explicit safeguards to only run during incident with approval.

lee: build pipeline snippet for attestations:
```
syft packages -o cyclonedx=json > sbom.json
cosign sign-blob --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign sbom.json
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI' -F 'manifest=@sbom.json' https://artifacts.internal/redwood/attest
```

tess: preflight checks for rollout team:
```
# verify seccomp profile applied
kubectl get pod -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile}' | grep runtime/default || echo MISSING
# confirm capabilities dropped
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.drop}' | grep NET_RAW || echo OK
# cosign verify
cosign verify --bundle -key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign registry.redwood/base:sha
```

omar: small edge: legacy packet-capture sidecar still needs NET_RAW. Proposal: move to restricted debug daemonset on a dedicated node pool rather than granting apps the cap.

hina: agree. include nodeAffinity + taint strategy in infra PR.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: [ ] RBAC migration PR merged (annotated SEC-7700), [ ] cluster KMS aliases provisioned, [ ] cosign signer rotated & tested, [ ] SBOM + attestation pipeline green, [ ] seccomp profile enforced in charts, [ ] canary schedule, [ ] runbook attached to SEC-7700.

lee: I'll take RBAC PR and pair with tess 11am today to ensure no privileged bindings slip through.

tess: will post a 30m warning in #release-war-room and monitor canary health. If rewrap errors >3x in a cluster or cosign verify fails for promoted tag, trigger incident and follow SEC-7700 runbook. :lock:
